title: Orange5 AtomSmasher Pathwave v0
description: AtomSmasher Pathwave — a compressed execution trajectory. A Pathwave is the canonical form of a sequence of (orange.order.v1 -> action -> orange.report.v1 -> receipt) tuples produced by a real run, reduced to the stable shape needed to replay, diff, or compare runs. The Pathwave preserves order, intent, outcome, and receipt anchor for every step; it discards verbose prose, log streams, and runtime nonces. pathwave_id = sha256(canonical({task, steps[]={order_id, intent_hash, action, status, confidence, evidence_hashes[], receipt_id}})). The id is derived, never stored. Persistence and replay live in sibling modules.

pathwave_id.description: sha256 hex of the canonical id payload. Deterministic: identical trajectories yield identical ids regardless of when they were compressed.

task.description: The task / mission label this trajectory was executed under. Free-form but non-empty; content-bearing (anti-fluff applies).

steps.description: Ordered list of compressed steps. Order is the execution order; the compressor never reorders.

stats.description: Honest accounting over the raw input vs the compressed output. Bytes are character counts of canonical JSON forms.

compression_ratio_bytes.description: output_bytes / input_bytes. Reported as 1 when input_bytes is 0 (degenerate empty trajectory).

warnings.description: Non-fatal honesty surface. Examples: 'missing_receipt: step[3]', 'order_intent_mismatch: step[5]', 'no_evidence: step[1]'. Empty array is fine.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of compression. Not part of pathwave_id.

index.description: 0-based position in the trajectory. Must match the step's index in the steps array.

order_id.description: The order.orderId that initiated this step.

intent_hash.description: sha256 of the order.intent string. Identifies what was asked without storing the full prose.

action.description: The action taken. Free-form short label; the order's first allowedAction is used by default, but the compressor accepts an explicit override on input.

status.description: The terminal status from orange.report.v1 (e.g. 'ok', 'failed', 'partial'). Free-form to match Report's permissive schema, but normalized lowercase.

evidence_hashes.description: sha256 of canonical JSON of each evidence object on the report. Preserves count and identity without storing payloads.

receipt_id.description: The receipt anchor for this step. Null when the order did not require a receipt; never silently fabricated.

risk_level.description: Optional carry-over from the order for replay gating.

next_action.description: Optional carry-over from the report. Truncated to 200 chars.
